construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored in the isolated build directory; no copied source.

input.synthetic: Required boolean true; real-data inputs are outside scope.
input.payload: JSON: {ACORD:{Submission:{canonical fields}}}; XML: <ACORD><Submission>scalar canonical tags</Submission></ACORD>; text: one canonical key: value per line, claims only.
input.config: Optional high_loss_amount positive finite threshold, entity-keyed categories, entity-keyed routes with required team and accountable owner role. Omitted entity overrides inherit defaults.

canonical_fields.summary: Nonempty bounded intake text, discarded before triage.
canonical_fields.loss_amount: Claims only, required finite number in [0,1000000000], single deployment currency, not a payment decision.
canonical_fields.loss_date: Claims only, required real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
canonical_fields.policyholder_vin_property_address: Optional bounded synthetic strings; never echoed or used for routing.
canonical_fields.underwriting_factors: Required nonempty list for underwriting: {name,value,disclosed:true}. Allowed names: roof_age_years, vehicle_age_years, coverage_requested. Ages are whole years 0..200. XML uses <underwriting_factors><Factor><name>...</name><value>...</value><disclosed>true</disclosed></Factor></underwriting_factors>.

shared_schema.output: One JSON object: status, schema_version, synthetic, minimized ticket, triage(category, priority, route, reasons, decision, coverage_decision, applied_rules), privacy and limitations. Errors return status:error and a sanitized message with exit code 2.
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate() layer handles every adapter, field allowlists, bounded values, required fields, disclosure, synthetic labeling and minimization. CLI additionally rejects duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite constants and oversized documents.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single functionality only: format adapter -> shared validation/minimization -> deterministic categorization, prioritization and accountable routing -> JSON serialization. No separate downstream stages.

behavior.categorization: Entity-driven categories with configurable operational category labels.
behavior.priority: High when explicitly urgent or claim amount >= configured threshold; normal otherwise. Evaluation order is fixed and all matching reasons are stated.
behavior.routing: Every entity maps to a team and accountable duty role; no external dispatch occurs.
behavior.claims_handling: Queue decisions have explicit reasons and are invariant to policyholder identity, address, VIN and narrative. Coverage, settlement and denial decisions are not made; human review is always required.
behavior.minimization: Raw personal fixture fields and narrative are discarded at normalization. Only an opaque reference and necessary domain fields appear in output. No persistence, logs or providers in the implementation.
behavior.underwriting: Hidden, unknown, duplicate and sensitive factors are rejected. Accepted disclosed factors are enumerated in the output for human review, not automatically scored.
behavior.fixture_generation: Synthetic example amount/date generated with random.Random(143): round(uniform(500,75000),2), then date(2025,1,1)+timedelta(days=randrange(600)). All people, VIN strings and addresses are invented.

included: Policy, claim and underwriting submission intake
Small ACORD-style JSON/XML imitation and claim-form text
Configurable categories, threshold priority and accountable role routing
Demonstrative fairness, minimization and factor-disclosure validation
excluded: Actual ACORD schema validation or certification
GDPR or insurance regulatory compliance certification
Coverage, liability, underwriting eligibility or payment decisions
Enterprise production controls, authentication, durable queues, SLA enforcement and delivery
Multi-currency conversion and full insurance policy semantics

test_outcomes.suite: 18 unittest test methods covering normal, edge, invalid-input, constraints, adapters, CLI behavior and determinism
test_outcomes.cli: Passed: exit 0, one valid JSON object, status ok, high-priority synthetic property claim routed to property_claims_duty_adjuster.
